title: One live lead per task: retire reports a kept predecessor and launch refuses a second lead
body: Evidence and root cause: .krn/runs/audit/system-audit.md, row D4.

Outcome: retireMode exits nonzero when the predecessor is still working; the successor launcher refuses a second live lead on the same task; a predecessor busy only with its own background agents counts as handoff-ready.
Proof: retire and launch unit tests with a working predecessor assert the exit and the refusal.
